title: L0-07 · The last emphasis and the pharyngals:ط ظ ع غ‎

blocks.text: L0-07 · The last emphasis and the pharyngals: ⁧ط ظ ع غ⁩

Complete the emphasis with ⁧ط⁩ and ⁧ظ⁩ and address ⁧ع⁩ , the most identity sound of Arabic: a full consonant produced in the pharynge, which an italophone tends to ignore. With ⁧غ⁩ Close the set of throat fricatives. This unit requires more oral training than the previous ones.

rows: 6–7 hours · one week at a standard pace

blocks.text: Materials This unit, calligraphy L0-07, Anki deck (tag L0-07), mirror, telephone to register
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize and write ⁧ط ظ ع غ⁩ in all forms, including the four very different forms of ⁧ع⁩ ;
2. produce ⁧ط⁩ and ⁧ظ⁩ as an emphasis on ⁧ت⁩ and ⁧ذ⁩ ;
3. produce ⁧ع⁩ as a sonorous pharyngal consonant and not to jump it;
4. produce ⁧غ⁩ as a veiled or uvular sound fricativa;
5. distinguish by ear t / ṭ, ḏ / ẓ / ḍ, ḫ / ġ, ḥ / ʿ.

rows: Section 2: training of ⁧ع⁩ (20 minutes) · forms of ⁧ع⁩ and ⁧غ⁩

blocks.text: • Sound. /tˤ/, t deaf emphasis, without suction: tip of the tongue as per ⁧ت⁩ , root of the tongue Backed up (see L0-06Section 2). The neighboring vowel darkens.
• Tracked. An eyelet stretched on the line, like that of ⁧ص⁩ , with a vertical rod raised above left. The four forms are very similar: only the connection changes.
• Sound. /ðˤ/, emphasis of ⁧ذ⁩ : Interdental sound with back tongue root. Many speakers, especially in
Egypt, they read it [zˤ], a z emphasis: recognize both, produce the dental.
• Tracked. How ⁧ط⁩ , with a point above the flagship.
1.3 Three sound letters not to be confused
• What is it? A consonant in all respects, /ʕ/: African (often approximate) pharyngal sound. Yes produces at the same point of ⁧ح⁩ , but with vocal cords vibrating.
1. Produce ⁧ح⁩ as in L0-05: compressed throat, no scraping.
2. Keep the same compression and add the entry: get a sound that's similar to a guttural. This is ⁧ع⁩ .
3. Test in syllable: ʿa, ʿi, ʿu, ʿā; then in the middle and at the end of the word: baʿd, maʿ, šaʿb.
4. Check: if your throat is relaxed you're only making a vowel; If there's a scraper you're doing ⁧غ⁩ .
• Because it matters. Jumping it changes the word: ⁧عَمَل⁩ ʿamal Work is done ⁧أَمَل⁩ ʾamal "Hope" (L0-09) differ only for ⁧ع⁩ .
• Transliteration. ʿ (an open apex on the left), not to be confused with ʾ hamza.

• Forms. They are very different from each other and must be learned apart: isolated ⁧ع⁩ ; initial ⁧عـ⁩ , a small open to left; median ⁧ـعـ⁩ , a small triangle closed and full; final ⁧ـع⁩ , triangle closed with tail under the row.

• Sound. /ɣ/, often [ ʁ ): Sail or uvular sound fricativa. It's the sound version of ⁧خ⁩ : same point, with the voice. It resembles the r of the French "Paris" and the so-called "Muscia" uvular that some Italians pronounce.
• How it is produced. Pronunciation ⁧خ⁩ long and add the voice, with a softer scraper.
• Forms. How ⁧ع⁩ , with one point above.
• Typical error. Pronouncing it: ġarb It is not "garb"
⁧ط⁩ and ⁧ظ⁩ are solar: ⁧الطَّالِب⁩ aṭ-ṭālib, ⁧الظَّرْف⁩ aẓ-ẓarf. ⁧ع⁩ and ⁧غ⁩ are lunar: ⁧العَمَل⁩ al-ʿamal, ⁧الغَرْب⁩ al-ġarb.
